# UKEN

> UKEN is a direct-trade marketplace connecting UK buyers with Kenyan farmers, artisans, and makers. Every product is traceable from maker to door.

UKEN sells specialty Kenyan coffee, tea, foods, textiles, beadwork, pottery, and craft. The platform pairs each product with the person who made it — their region, craft, and story — and ships directly from Kenya to the UK.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Shop authentic Kenyan goods, traced from maker to UK door.
- [Shop](/shop): Full catalogue — coffee, tea, foods, textiles, beadwork, pottery.

- [About UKEN](/about): Who we are, what we do, and how UKEN works.
- [Our story, mission and vision](/story): The bridge between Kenyan producers and UK buyers.
- [Sustainability](/sustainability): How UKEN trades fairly and traces every chain.
- [Transparency](/transparency): Pricing, payouts, and producer relationships.
- [Press and partners](/press): Media information and academic partners.
- [Contact](/contact): Nottingham and Nairobi offices, plus general enquiries.
- [Join UKEN](/join): For Kenyan producers who want to sell through UKEN.
- [Track an order](/orders/track): Look up the status of a UKEN order.
